say:1:1034409001:1.text: I have not been fortunate enough to view the Deer Spirit with my own eyes, for I am not a chosen one.
say:1:1034409001:1.source_cn: 我的确未能亲眼目赌鹿灵的身姿，因为我不是被祂选中的人。
say:1:1034409001:1.male: I have not been fortunate enough to view the Deer Spirit with my own eyes, for I am not a chosen one.
say:1:1034409001:1.female: I have not been fortunate enough to view the Deer Spirit with my own eyes, for I am not a chosen one.

say:2:1034409002:1.text: But some have indeed witnessed her grace. She is everywhere... in the Wise Grove, near the sacred mound, even deep in the streams beneath the cliffs.
say:2:1034409002:1.source_cn: 但有人曾见过祂，在这片贤人林，在圣丘附近，又或山崖下的...
say:2:1034409002:1.male: But some have indeed witnessed her grace. She is everywhere... in the Wise Grove, near the sacred mound, even deep in the streams beneath the cliffs.
say:2:1034409002:1.female: But some have indeed witnessed her grace. She is everywhere... in the Wise Grove, near the sacred mound, even deep in the streams beneath the cliffs.

say:3:1034409003:1.text: However, no one I know has ever seen the Deer Spirit in person.
say:3:1034409003:1.source_cn: 在我认识的人中，还没有哪个亲眼见过鹿灵呢。
say:3:1034409003:1.male: However, no one I know has ever seen the Deer Spirit in person.
say:3:1034409003:1.female: However, no one I know has ever seen the Deer Spirit in person.
